svg.title: What a pitch deck costs in November 2026
svg.desc: Mobile version. Bar chart of published pitch deck design prices in November 2026. Design of your own content: Slidebean R14,382, LulaZel Hub from R18,000, Pitch Deck Creators R27,000, Pitchfast R44,982. With story writing: Pitchfast R62,982, Pitch Deck Creators from R90,000, Waveup from R108,000, Slidebean strategy sprint from R108,000.
